## Core Expertise
CRT-to-LCD retrofit modules for legacy CNC display systems across all major brands.
Plug-and-play replacement using original connectors and mounting. No CNC parameter
changes required. Custom solutions for non-standard signal interfaces available.
Replacement LCDs use the original CRT's connector pinout and are drop-in — no
rewiring, no machine modification.

## Replacement Specs by Model
Kongto LCD replacement modules. Every replacement uses the original CRT's
connector and mounts in the original frame. Signal is converted internally —
machine controls see an unchanged video signal.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- Does the replacement work with my CNC machine? Yes. The LCD uses the same connector
  and pinout as the original CRT, and the video signal is converted internally. No CNC
  parameter changes and no machine modification are needed. It is plug-and-play.
- Can you match a non-listed FANUC A61L-xxxx-xxxx part number? Usually yes. Most FANUC
  9" and 14" CRTs map to a standard 8" or 12.1" replacement. Send your part number via
  the quote form and we confirm compatibility the same day.
- What about the high-voltage CRT risk? The replacement runs on low-voltage DC (24V) or
  AC 110-220V instead of the 10-15kV CRT anode supply — safer and longer-lived.
- What is the LCD lifetime? 50,000+ hours vs roughly 15,000 hours for a worn CRT tube.
  Brightness holds at 350-450 cd/m² versus ~200 cd/m² for an aging tube.
- Do I keep the original brightness/contrast controls? Yes, the original front-panel
  controls continue to work with the replacement module.
- Shipping to my country? We ship factory-direct worldwide — USA, Germany, UK, Japan,
  South Korea, Singapore, India, Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, Philippines. See the
  country pages below for details.
- Do you offer custom sizes/signals? Yes. Non-standard interfaces and sizes (KTV custom
  series) are available for OEM and batch orders.
